messages.text: The reconciliation confirms the partial implementation edits are syntactically valid and the new size/relative-time outputs match the official probes, while the verifier still lacks those cases. One source-derived correction remains before expanding tests: in tree mode `--only-files` removes an explicit directory root before recursion, producing no output; I’m applying that exact rule, then adding the omitted cases to the current verifier with smaller context-safe edits.

commands.preview: $ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); & $ref --color=never --icons=never -T -f rust-reference/tests/itest/a rust-reference/tests/itest/vagrant; & $ref --color=never --icons=never -T -D rust-reference/tests/itest/a rust-reference/tests/itest/vagrant; & $ref --color=never --icons=never -T --no-symlinks rust-reference/tests/itest/vagrant
